scope: Locked macOS desktop plugin/API source; no execution or native permission claim

observations.dialog_init: desktop init clones AppHandle; plugin setup manages Dialog. Native picker effects occur when selected later.
observations.notification_init: desktop init clones AppHandle; setup manages Notification. This does not claim permission/native delivery acceptance.
observations.runtime_registration: Locked tauri app.rs AppHandle::plugin_boxed initializes then registers a plugin; runtime normal-only registration is supported in source. Must happen before creating normal window needing init scripts; exact startup sequencing still needs implementation tests.
observations.store: Existing source census: manages empty StoreState; Exit saves loaded stores. No recovery store loads permitted.
observations.single_instance: Existing source census: identifier-derived /tmp socket coordination, second-process exit and cleanup. Not side-effect-free.
